# Ali - Portfolio

> Portfolio of Aliasger Adamally (Ali), a visual designer based in Singapore. He creates brand identities, digital experiences, film, editorial design and visual storytelling.

## About

Aliasger Adamally is a multidisciplinary visual designer whose work connects strategy, identity and digital execution. He works across visual identity systems, web and e-commerce experiences, art direction, film and editorial design.

## Areas of practice

- Visual design and art direction
- Brand identity and brand systems
- Digital experiences and e-commerce design
- Editorial design and visual storytelling
- Film and motion

## Selected industry experience

- MIU Global: internship work spanning client pitches, MIU Meet and a brand redesign document.
- 360&5: E-Commerce and Design Intern supporting a rotating portfolio of more than 30 client accounts, across design, development and project management.

## Contact

For commissions, collaborations and opportunities, use the contact details on the portfolio's Contact page.
